Celina Jaitly advocates for prenuptial agreements for women

Actress Celina Jaitly has advised women to consider signing prenuptial agreements before marriage. She emphasized the importance of keeping assets separate to ensure financial security. The actress's statement highlights discussions around financial planning and asset protection within marital relationships.
